pages.html:
🏋 IRONCLAD FITNESS
  • Home
  • Why Us
  • Plans
  • Testimonials
  • Contact

Ironclad Fitness — Gym Memberships & Training

Riverside's toughest gym floor, friendliest coaches. Strength training, group classes, and recovery space under one roof — built for every goal, from your first rep to your next PR.

See Membership PlansBook a Free Tour

Why Train With Us

Everything you need to get stronger, recover faster, and stay consistent — all included with membership.

Full Strength Floor

Olympic platforms, squat racks, and a full dumbbell range up to 120 lbs — never wait for equipment during peak hours.

50+ Weekly Classes

HIIT, spin, yoga, and boxing led by certified coaches, included free with every membership tier.

Recovery Zone

Sauna, foam rolling stations, and stretch mats so your next session starts stronger than the last.

Membership Plans

Simple pricing, no hidden fees. Cancel or switch plans anytime.

Compare monthly membership plans
PlanBasicStandardElite
Monthly Price$29$49$79
Gym Floor AccessYesYesYes
Group Classes—UnlimitedUnlimited
Sauna & Recovery Zone—YesYes
Personal Training Sessions—1 / month4 / month
Guest Passes—1 / month4 / month
Other Locations——All Riverside branches
Get StartedChoose BasicChoose StandardChoose Elite

What Our Members Say

“I've tried three gyms in Riverside and this is the only one I've stuck with for over a year. The coaches actually know your name.”

— Marcus Webb, Standard member

“Signed up for Elite for the personal training and it completely changed my squat form. Lost 18 lbs in four months.”

— Priya Anand, Elite member

“The 6am spin class is the best part of my week. Clean equipment, great music, zero attitude.”

— Dana Reyes, Standard member

Join Ironclad Fitness

Fill out the form and a member of our team will reach out within one business day to set up your free trial day.
